title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Numbers 15: the meal and drink offerings, the first of the dough, sins done unwittingly or with a high hand, the Sabbath breaker, and the fringes.

questions.text: How much fine flour was offered as a meal offering with each lamb?
questions.explanation: With each lamb a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil, was to be offered.

questions.text: How much wine was offered as the drink offering with a ram?
questions.explanation: For a ram the drink offering was the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

answers.text: A fourth of a hin of wine
A third of a hin of wine
Half of a hin of wine

questions.text: What rule applied to a stranger living among Israel who offered an offering by fire?
questions.explanation: There was to be one law and one ordinance for Israel and for the stranger living among them; as Israel did, so he should do.

answers.text: He had to offer through a Levite
The same law applied to him as to Israel
He was not allowed to offer

questions.text: What were they to offer from the first of their dough?
questions.explanation: Of the first of their dough they were to offer up a cake for a wave offering.

answers.text: A cake for a wave offering

questions.text: What did the congregation offer for a sin done unwittingly by the whole congregation?
questions.explanation: The congregation offered one young bull for a burnt offering with its meal and drink offering, and one male goat for a sin offering.

answers.text: A young bull and a male goat

questions.text: What did a single person who sinned unwittingly offer as a sin offering?
questions.explanation: If a person sinned unwittingly, he was to offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

answers.text: A female goat a year old

questions.text: What was to happen to the soul who did anything with a high hand?
questions.explanation: The soul who acted with a high hand, native-born or foreigner, blasphemed Yahweh and was to be cut off from among his people.

answers.text: He was to pay a fifth part
He was to wash his clothes
He was to wait outside seven days
He was to be cut off from his people

questions.text: What was the man found doing on the Sabbath day in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: While Israel was in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

questions.text: What did Yahweh command to be done with the man who gathered sticks on the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said the man should be put to death, stoned by all the congregation outside of the camp, and they did so.

answers.text: He was to be put in custody for a year
He was to be stoned outside of the camp
He was to be shut out for seven days
He was to bring a sin offering

questions.text: What was to be put on the fringe of each border of their garments?
questions.explanation: They were to make fringes on the borders of their garments and put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.
